prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, channel mix, industry and whether you need enterprise-level data engineering, creative + AI, or local SMB performance work. I can, however, shortlist respected LA-area agencies that are known for using AI/data-driven approaches and tell you how to pick the best fit.

Notable LA-area agencies to consider
- R/GA (LA office) — strong at product + creative that integrates data and machine learning for brand and digital products. Good for larger brands that want tech-driven creative.
- Wpromote (El Segundo/LA) — performance-focused, uses data science and automation across paid search, social and programmatic. Good for growth and ROI-driven campaigns.
- Scorpion (LA/Irvine) — focuses on local businesses (legal, healthcare, home services) with automation and AI-backed lead generation and CRM tools.
- VaynerMedia (LA) — integrated social and brand work with growing use of AI tooling for content scale and analytics. Good for consumer brands and social-first strategies.
- Merkle (client data, personalization) — enterprise CRM, data-driven personalization and measurement; strong for customer data platforms and personalization at scale.
- Metric Theory (LA) — performance paid-media agency using algorithmic optimization and automation to scale acquisition campaigns.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Goal alignment: brand building vs. direct response vs. personalization/CRM.
- Evidence: ask for case studies with KPIs, not just creative samples.
- Tech stack: what ML tools, CDP, analytics platforms do they use? Do they build proprietary models?
- Data access & privacy: can they integrate your first‑party data securely? GDPR/CCPA compliance?
- Team & expertise: do they have data scientists, ML engineers, and creatives on the team?
- Measurement & reporting: how will they attribute results and report ROI?
- Budget & timeline: some agencies focus on enterprise retainer work, others on performance campaigns or pilots.

If you want, I can:
- Narrow this list to 3 best fits if you tell me your industry, budget, and primary goals (e.g., scale paid ads, personalization, chatbots, predictive LTV).
- Draft a short RFP or intro email you can send to any agency to evaluate them quickly.

Which direction do you want to take?
